workflows.name: Retail Account Onboarding

steps.name: Search for an existing customer record
Resolve ambiguous customer matches if required
Review potential screening matches if required
Assess customer risk and additional evidence needs
Collect and assess enhanced evidence if required
Create or link the customer master
Create the account using an idempotent request
Verify account readiness and activate access
Notify the customer and close the case

workflows.routing_requirement:
Expand identity, duplicate resolution, screening, product, and access
controls into 24 activities. Evidence failure returns to step 6 and repeats
step 7 and step 8. An ambiguous match enters step 11 before step 12; otherwise
bypass step 11. A screening hit enters step 13 for clearance, hold, or decline;
clear cases proceed to step 14. Product ineligibility returns to step 16 for
an eligible selection or closes as declined. Approval corrections return to
the affected capture/check and repeat step 19. Provisioning retries only the
failed step 20, step 21, or step 22, then repeat readiness at step 23.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add original-document inspection, staff attestation, signature, and
handover controls rather than copying the digital route. Discrepancies at
step 10 enter step 11 then repeat step 6 through step 10; clear cases bypass
step 11. Unreadable copies repeat step 8. Screening hits stop at step 16 until
clearance or decline. Checker findings return to the affected evidence step
and repeat step 23 and step 24. Failed handover returns to step 27 after
identity correction without recreating the account. The branch interpretation
of Variant A remains a proposed design assumption.

steps.name: Record the applicant's authority and consent
Capture business activities and expected turnover
Identify beneficial owners under the applicable policy
Screen owners and relevant associated parties
Collect enhanced business evidence if required
Resolve duplicate company matches if required
Validate signing rules and authority evidence
Independently review the ownership and mandate pack
Create or link the company customer master
Activate the mandate and notify the company

Expand ownership tracing, associated-party checks, and signing controls.
Ownership gaps return to step 9 and repeat dependent identity/screening checks.
Company screening at step 16 and party screening at step 17 may run in parallel
after their inputs are ready; both must finish before step 18. Mandate defects
return to step 24 and repeat step 25, step 27, and step 28. Unresolved ownership
or screening issues hold/decline the case. Permission-test failures repeat
step 31, not account opening.

process.Process Description: Fast-track onboarding for low-risk SME profiles

steps.Process Step: Submit onboarding request - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Requestor submits onboarding requests with mandatory attributes and evidence references; Tracking ID created.

steps.Process Step: Triage and classify - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Ops reviews request, classifies route (FD/SA), urgency, sets SLA and assigns maker.

steps.Process Step: Completeness gateway - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Mandatory fields/evidence check; fail → AOB-PR-1002-V02-S004, pass → AOB-PR-1002-V02-S005.

steps.Process Step: Request clarification (fail path) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Return to requestor with reason codes; loop to AOB-PR-1002-V02-S003.

steps.Process Step: Business approval - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Business approver confirms request is valid and authorised.

steps.Process Step: Approval event gateway - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Wait for approve/reject/withdraw/timeout; timeout → escalation.

steps.Process Step: Create onboarding draft - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Maker maps request to draft, creates v1 + change log.

steps.Process Step: Package for ingestion - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Create ingestion package, apply naming/checksum/encryption.

steps.Process Step: Ingest to landing - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Platform ingests package; schema validation.

steps.Process Step: Technical error handling - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Incident created; retry/park decision (max 2 retries).

steps.Process Step: Parallel validations start - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Run DQ, enrichment, duplicate detection in parallel; join at AOB-PR-1002-V02-S015.

steps.Process Step: Execute DQ ruleset - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Automated DQ checks: completeness, code sets, date logic, uniqueness.

steps.Process Step: Reference enrichment - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Standardize country/currency/team codes.

steps.Process Step: Duplicate detect & merge decision - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Detect duplicates; merge/reject/proceed decision.

steps.Process Step: Validation join - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Consolidate parallel outputs into Validated Draft.

steps.Process Step: Conditional SPECIALIST checks - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Determine if Process SPECIALIST review is required based on explicit Tax Review Basis derived from Process Status and Process Type.

steps.Process Step: Process SPECIALIST review (conditional) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: SPECIALIST reviews tax-triggered cases.

steps.Process Step: DQ pass gateway - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Evaluate DQ + Merge + Specialist outcomes; fail → AOB-PR-1002-V02-S019, pass → AOB-PR-1002-V02-S020.

steps.Process Step: Remediation loop - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Maker corrects and resubmits; max 3 attempts; loop to AOB-PR-1002-V02-S011.

steps.Process Step: Maker-checker (4-eye) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Checker reviews, approves/rejects with reasons; logged for audit.

steps.Process Step: Publish to onboarding master - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Publish to Azure Data Lake master; stamp lineage/audit.

steps.Process Step: Write controls & DQ metrics - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Persist DQ results, approvals, remediation history to controls dataset.

steps.Process Step: Distribute to Downstream Systems (transaction) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Parallel fan-out; record per-consumer status; allow replay.

steps.Process Step: Publish to DDT (alias: External Consumer A (Market Data) or Downstream Consumer A) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Produce DDT-specific extract and deliver.

steps.Process Step: Publish to Portfolio Analytics Platform (ANALYTICS CONSUMER B (HACKATHON) OR AZURE SYNAPSE/DATABRICKS ANALYTICS WORKSPACE) (alias: Analytics Platform) - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Deliver via API MANAGEMENT + AZURE FUNCTIONS (OR API INTEGRATION LAYER (AZURE API MANAGEMENT)) to Analytics Consumer B with retries and idempotency using Tracking ID.

steps.Process Step Description: Publish event/message to Reporting Consumer C (Hackathon) or Downstream Reporting Hub (Consumer C) via Azure Service Bus Topic.

steps.Process Step: Record publication events - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Append delivery events for audit/replay/monitoring.

steps.Process Step: Update DQ dashboard - SME Account Opening - Express
steps.Process Step Description: Refresh dashboard with status + DQ metrics.

steps.Process Step Description: Notify requestor/stakeholders with outcome + Tracking ID.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Keep this route shorter because validated evidence is reused. Failure
at step 4 transfers to WF-03 step 3; stale evidence at step 6 transfers to
WF-03 step 6; changed ownership at step 7 transfers to WF-03 step 9. Screening
hits transfer to WF-03 step 18 with both screening results. Transfers retain
the case/evidence and end express processing. No screening concerns are
automatically cleared; changed mandate data is revalidated before step 16.

workflows.name: Corporate KYC Remediation

steps.name: Assign a case owner and review priority
Confirm the customer and linked legal entities
Compare existing data with those requirements
Record response deadlines and communication preferences
Update expected activity and funding information
Assess adverse information where required by policy
Submit the revised KYC pack for independent review
Approve the revised risk and review outcome
Apply approved KYC changes with version history
Record any authorised restriction or removal of restriction
Synchronise the approved customer risk information
Set the next review trigger or date
Notify relevant owners and close the review

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add population selection, evidence gaps, ownership refresh, approval,
and controlled downstream updates without creating a new account. Incomplete
evidence at step 11 returns to step 8. Non-response at step 9 enters an owned
escalation, not assumed closure/restriction. Contradictions at step 25 return
to the affected evidence task and re-run dependent checks. Reviewer correction
at step 27 returns to step 7 and requires step 26 through step 28 again.
Screening branches at step 19 and step 20 join before step 21. Delivery failures
repeat only step 31 for the unacknowledged destination, then step 32.

steps.name: Validate event origin and required fields

Detect duplicate or already handled events
Define the impacted KYC fields and controls
Preserve unaffected evidence with its validity basis
Update changed corporate or activity fields
Reconstruct affected ownership relationships if required
Verify newly affected parties if required
Reassess the effect on customer risk
Apply versioned changes with the originating event ID
Update impacted monitoring or restriction instructions
Confirm acknowledgement and record event disposition

workflows.routing_requirement:
Scope remediation to a material event instead of redoing the full KYC
population review. Duplicate events at step 4 link to the existing case and
close; non-material events at step 7 close with rationale. Bad evidence at
step 12 returns to step 11. New material facts return to step 7 and recompute
scope; reviewer corrections return to step 8 and repeat step 20 and step 21.
Downstream retries resume step 24 only for affected failed destinations.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Expand trade risk, credit, legal execution, and entitlement testing.
Screening concerns stop at step 13 pending clearance/decline. Credit changes
return to step 17 and repeat step 18 through step 21. Legal defects return to
step 22; material term changes require credit reapproval at step 21. Missing
prerequisites hold step 25. Entitlement failures return to step 30 or step 31,
then repeat step 33 and step 34 before activation.

steps.name: Identify the parent and participating legal entities
Confirm the sponsor's authority for each entity
Define requested products and countries by entity
Capture entity transaction volumes and currencies
Screen each entity and associated parties
Assess entity trade restrictions and counterparties
Resolve entity screening concerns if required
Collect entity financial and credit evidence
Review local legal capacity and agreement requirements
Assess cross-guarantees and shared collateral if required
Draft entity agreements and local addenda
Complete group and local legal review
Obtain authorised group and entity signatures
Record the explicitly approved entity activation scope
Independently review group and entity setup packs
Create or link the group facility hierarchy
Configure signatory and maker/checker rules per entity
Activate only the approved entities and products
Issue entity-specific confirmations and record exclusions

workflows.routing_requirement:
Run step 7 through step 19 per entity, then join at step 20 before
group exposure work. Failed entity checks return to that entity's evidence
or review task, not completed peers. Entity exclusion at step 30 requires
step 21 through step 24 again with the changed scope and affected legal
review, then step 30 and step 31. Failed tests return to the affected step 33,
step 34, or step 35 before repeating step 37 through step 40. Readiness joins
must cover all explicitly in-scope entities; no silent partial completion.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Separate credit, legal execution, independent instruction validation,
and operational readiness. Agreement corrections return to step 16 and repeat
step 17 and step 18; changed credit terms also repeat step 13 and step 14.
Instruction failures return to step 20 and repeat step 21 and step 22. Failed
routing tests return to step 26; permission failures return to step 27. Both
approved limits and verified instructions are required before step 29.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add status, funding, liquidity, governance, and collateral controls.
Unresolved status at step 5 enters hold/decline; evidence remediation repeats
step 5 and step 6 before progression. Funding gaps return to step 9, and
enhanced-diligence gaps return to step 16. Collateral changes return to step 22
and repeat approval at step 24 plus affected agreements. Settlement failures
return to step 29. Readiness test failures return only to the affected step 34,
step 35, or step 36 and repeat step 37; no unrestricted activation is allowed.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Decompose suitability into capacity, knowledge, experience, tolerance,
and acknowledgement, without unnecessary account provisioning. Incomplete
responses return from step 13 to the affected capture task. Contradictions
enter step 15 then repeat step 14; consistent responses bypass step 15.
Declined acknowledgement at step 19 returns to step 18 for discussion, then
to affected assessment tasks if facts change, or closes as withdrawn. A profile
is not approval of a particular trade.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Expand wealth evidence, complex assets, entity assessments, and mandate
restrictions. Bad wealth evidence returns to step 6 and repeat step 7 and
step 8. Entity-specific assessments may run independently but must reconcile
at step 25 before consolidation. Scope exclusions require step 5 again and
reassessment of consolidated capacity. Reviewer issues enter step 28 then
return to the affected assessment and repeat step 26 and step 27. Step 32
requires all acknowledgements in the approved scope; missing consent cannot
be treated as a successful join.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Separate affordability, credit, issuance, delivery, and activation.
Identity failure returns to step 4. Missing credit evidence returns to step 10
or step 11 and repeats assessment; decline at step 14 ends the application.
Failed delivery at step 22 returns to step 18 and retries step 21 only for
the existing issued card. Authentication failure at step 23 holds activation
for verified correction and bounded retry; it never triggers new issuance.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add partner referral, separate consents, membership, and rewards-link
controls. Duplicate referrals at step 3 reuse the existing case. Membership
errors enter step 7 then return to step 5; ineligible cases close. Credit
decline at step 16 stops issuance. After step 23, rewards work at step 24 and
step 25 may run parallel to delivery/activation at step 26 through step 29;
both join at step 30. Failed linkage retries step 24 only. Failed delivery
returns to step 21 and step 26, not issuance. Combined completion requires
both branches even if the card is already active.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add activity restrictions, payment exposure, ownership verification,
and transaction/settlement certification. Prohibited activity at step 10
declines; uncertain activity enters step 12 for a decision. Underwriting
corrections return to step 13 or step 14 and repeat step 15 through step 18.
Account-validation errors return to step 21. Failed tests enter step 31,
return to the affected step 25 through step 28, and repeat step 29 and step 30.
Passed tests bypass step 31; processing remains disabled until step 32.

workflows.name: Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.name: Identify the sponsor and authorised entity representatives
Map outlets, brands, channels, and countries
Define proposed rollout scope and waves
Capture goods and services by channel
Assess merchant categories and restricted activities
Resolve entity screening concerns if required
Capture channel volumes and transaction profiles
Assess channel fulfilment and chargeback exposure
Review channel fraud and security controls
Aggregate enterprise payment and settlement exposure
Define enterprise limits and reserve requirements
Capture settlement accounts by entity and currency
Configure limits, fraud rules, and access rights
Test authorisation and capture per channel
Test refunds and exception handling per channel
Test settlement and reconciliation per channel
Resolve channel certification findings if required
Aggregate readiness for the proposed rollout wave
Approve wave activation and rollback arrangements
Resolve or roll back failed wave components if required
Approve progression to the next wave if any
Close programme onboarding and hand off monitoring

process.Process Description: Complex onboarding for large enterprise merchants

steps.Process Step: Submit onboarding request - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise
steps.Process Step Description: Requestor submits onboarding requests with mandatory attributes and evidence references; Tracking ID created.

steps.Process Step: Triage and classify - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step Description: Mandatory fields/evidence check; fail → AOB-PR-1008-V02-S004, pass → AOB-PR-1008-V02-S005.

steps.Process Step: Request clarification (fail path) - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise
steps.Process Step Description: Return to requestor with reason codes; loop to AOB-PR-1008-V02-S003.

steps.Process Step Description: Business approver confirms request is valid and authorised.

steps.Process Step: Approval event gateway - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise
steps.Process Step Description: Wait for approve/reject/withdraw/timeout; timeout → escalation.

steps.Process Step: Package for ingestion - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step: Ingest to landing - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step: Technical error handling - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise
steps.Process Step Description: Incident created; retry/park decision (max 2 retries).

steps.Process Step: Parallel validations start - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise
steps.Process Step Description: Run DQ, enrichment, duplicate detection in parallel; join at AOB-PR-1008-V02-S015.

steps.Process Step: Execute DQ ruleset - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step: Reference enrichment - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step: Duplicate detect & merge decision - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step: Conditional SPECIALIST checks - Merchant Onboarding - Enterprise

steps.Process Step Description: Parallel fan-out; record per-consumer status; allow replay.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add enterprise hierarchy, aggregate underwriting, channel certification,
and controlled rollout. Entity/channel reviews join at step 16. Certification
at step 34 through step 37 runs per channel; failures return only to affected
configuration at step 29 through step 33 and retest. Each wave joins at step 38
and needs step 39 approval. Failed production checks at step 41 enter step 42
for owned remediation/rollback and return to affected certification before
step 38; settled transactions must not be blindly reversed. Healthy waves
bypass step 42. Step 43 advances to step 38 for the next defined wave, bounded
by the approved wave list; after the last wave proceed to step 44. Completed
waves are never reactivated by retry.

workflows.routing_requirement:
Expand party identity, authority, relationships, and origination handoff
without adding lending decisions to setup. Evidence gaps return to step 6.
Ambiguous matches enter step 9 then repeat step 8; clear matches bypass it.
Authority failures return to step 16. Relationship corrections return to
step 14 or step 15, repeat step 18, then step 19 and step 20. Handoff failures
retry step 22 without duplicating master records. This does not approve or
disburse a loan.

steps.name: Link the origination case and proposed security references
Identify guarantors and third-party security providers
Capture each party's identity and contact details
Collect individual or entity identity evidence
Search for existing party master matches
Capture relevant ownership and control structures
Collect authority to act and sign for each party
Capture asset/security references supplied by the applicant
Compare ownership evidence with security-provider identities
Identify joint owners or additional required providers
Obtain missing party consents or authority evidence if required
Link parties to the appropriate collateral references
Validate guarantor and security-provider relationship scope
Record reported competing interests for downstream legal review
Identify outstanding valuation and legal-perfection prerequisites
Reconcile the identity, authority, and security linkage pack
Obtain specialist clarification of linkage ambiguities if required
Independently review the complete party/security pack
Approve party data and proposed linkage scope
Create or link party master records
Publish the package with unresolved downstream prerequisites
Confirm receipt by origination and collateral/legal owners
Close setup and hand off outstanding prerequisite ownership

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add security-provider identification, ownership comparison, joint-party
consent, and explicit downstream legal/valuation handoff. Ownership mismatch
at step 22 returns to step 21; newly identified providers at step 23 repeat
step 4 through step 19 for those parties only. Missing authority returns to
step 18. Linkage issues at step 26 or step 30 return to step 25 and repeat
step 29 through step 32. Failed handoff retries step 35 only. Step 28 and
step 35 must preserve unresolved valuation, perfection, and lending gates;
setup completion cannot imply those downstream decisions are approved.

steps.name: Confirm client identity and representative authority
Retrieve or collect client diligence evidence
Verify legal identity and relevant ownership details
Screen the client and relevant parties
Identify requested custody services and asset types
Determine eligible markets and investor status
Agree account ownership and segregation requirements
Agree reporting recipients and delivery formats
Present custody terms and fee arrangements

Test settlement, servicing, and reporting readiness
Approve readiness and activate the account
Confirm activation and hand off to custody operations

workflows.routing_requirement:
Separate custody ownership, tax, settlement, servicing, and reporting
controls. Ineligible market requests at step 8 are excluded with explicit
scope agreement or declined. Tax failures return to step 9; instruction
failures return to step 13 and repeat step 14. Checker changes require
step 18 and step 19 again. Failed tests return to the affected step 21 through
step 24 and repeat step 25; account creation is not repeated. Restricted
markets remain disabled at activation.

Activate only approved markets and currencies
Notify stakeholders and track deferred-market follow-up

workflows.routing_requirement:
Add local registration, tax, sub-custody, currency, and servicing
controls. Step 9 through step 26 runs independently per market; unresolved
eligibility at step 9 holds that market rather than proceeding. Documentary
failures return to the affected step 13, step 15, or step 18 and revalidate.
After scope approval, step 28 through step 36 runs per market; failed tests
enter step 36 then return to affected configuration at step 29 through step 33
and retest. Readiness joins at step 37 cover the approved scope only. Changing
scope at step 38 requires step 27 approval again; exclusions remain recorded
as deferred/declined, never complete. Already active markets are not replayed.
